reason: I'd probably poke at the 10 free DMs, but I wouldn't pay $147 a month on something with zero customer results and a dashboard that sounds like another thing I'd have to babysit. I'm under $5k a month, so a tool I cancel after a trial is the likely outcome.
objection: It only sends while my Chrome has an Instagram tab open, so it's me sitting there for hours anyway, and no one has shown it books a single call. $147 on faith is a lot when my leads still live in a Google Sheet.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from founding members (booked calls from the DMs, not just sent counts), plus a price closer to $79 or a lower tier with fewer DMs.
